The printed figure shows the 'Absorption by plant roots' arrow pointing back into soil water and double-headed Plant body-Ingestion and Ingestion-Animal body arrows; drawn as soil water -> absorption by plant roots -> plant body -> ingestion by animals -> animal body (correct).

findings: Fig 25.2 arrows corrected: water moves from soil water through absorption by plant roots into the plant body, and from the plant body through ingestion into the animal body (RU tip).
